While Spanish colonizers may have been influenced by Vitruvius, the bahay na bato is indigenous synthesis, not direct application. Vernacular architecture does not sacrifice durability; stone base and proper timber joinery ensure firmitas. Bahay na bato integrates all three principles: structurally sound stone and timber (firmitas), climate-responsive spatial organization (utilitas), and proportionate graceful form (venustas).
